name: io.github.tonyyang0504/noon-mcp
description: noon (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool m

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: key_id from your noon service-account key file (.json), created in the noon Partner portal.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: private_key (PEM) from the same service-account key file; it signs the RS256 login JWT.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_PROJECT_CODE
environmentVariables.description: project_code from the key file, sent as default_project_code at login.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_WAREHOUSE_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Integration warehouse code for stock updates and FBPI order listing (see ListWarehouses).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NOON_COUNTRY_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Marketplace country code for pricing (e.g. ae, sa, eg).
